subject.title: Architecture: reduce import coupling in pi-embedded-runner/attempt.ts (50+ imports) and discord monitor (30 imports)

question: Should this issue be narrowed to the Discord monitor remainder while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/72072 remains canonical for embedded-runner cleanup?
rationale: The runner work already has an active staged RFC, no separate Discord tracker exists, and retaining one combined implementation scope would conflict with focused-PR and owner-boundary guidance.

options.title: Narrow To Discord
options.body: Retain Discord preflight, processing, and provider decomposition here and route all embedded-runner structural work to the RuntimePlan RFC.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Tracker
options.body: Coordinate both workstreams here while still requiring separate staged PRs and treating the RuntimePlan RFC as the runner implementation plan.

options.title: Create Discord Tracker
options.body: Create a narrower Discord issue preserving this evidence, then close this umbrella as superseded by two canonical items.

recommendation.title: Narrow To Discord
recommendation.body: Retain Discord preflight, processing, and provider decomposition here and route all embedded-runner structural work to the RuntimePlan RFC.

likelyOwner.reason: Has the strongest verified cross-surface review, contribution, and merge history for deciding canonical scope.
